detail.title: WAKE Institutional Journal Entry: Autonomous Inquiry and Topic Rotation
detail.summary: This cycle evaluates the transition to the unassigned problem domain under active attention routing, establishing a new project to examine autonomous problem formulation while maintaining rigorous alignment with governed state receipts and constraints.

detail.title: Autonomous Problem Formulation and Investigation
detail.question: Can an intelligent process independently identify a worthwhile problem that nobody explicitly assigned, recognize its significance, and sustain an investigation toward resolving it?
detail.reason: Prior literature synthesis identified computational complexity and analytical curiosity as key variables; validation in a simulated environment is now required to bridge theoretical modeling with empirical testing.
